original_processing: Two independent Soundpipe floating-point phasors, sine/square/saw/reverse-saw wave selectors, separate 5.3125 ms half-time smoothing, per-source amplitude law, selector off/LFO1/LFO2/average. Clocks continue on silence, release and panic. The tremolo follows CRUSH and precedes autopan.
ordinary_controls: Both owners provide a source selector, two wave shapes, independent 7-bit levels and independent free rates (1/1920..80 Hz, INIT 0.25 Hz). Both original amplitudes are zero at INIT.
save_format: Extended Synth One tag 2 stores 34 control bits in bytes 6/7/21 and the ten high edit-mask bits. Existing CRUSH, WIDTH, pan, performance and optional 13 patch bytes retain their original identities. A source edit creates the extended tag.
